entries.rule: Some Beyonder abilities and supernatural effects deal damage directly to the spirit body rather than the physical body. Spirit body damage pierces Damage Resistance (DR) — physical and spiritual DR provide no protection against it.

For every point of spirit body damage taken, the victim suffers a disadvantage to the next roll: -1 per point of damage. The penalty applies to a single roll (any roll the player makes — attack, defense, skill, Will, HT, or SPI) and then clears.
Some forms of spirit damage also add Corruption (CoR) to the victim — the ability that deals the damage states the amount.
